description: This file provides TypeScript type declarations for the Node.js 'module' internal APIs, including module system interfaces, functions for resolving modules, require hooks, source map support, and related utilities.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Node.js internal module, with properties like id, filename, paths, children, and methods for requiring other modules.

classes.name: SourceMap
classes.description: Represents a source map, allowing for mapping between generated and original source code lines and columns.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Function to import modules within the Node.js environment.

methods.name: createRequire
methods.description: Creates a require function for a given path or URL.

methods.name: findPackageJSON
methods.description: Finds the nearest package.json file for a given module specifier and base.

methods.name: enableCompileCache
methods.description: Enables the Node.js module compile cache in the current process.

methods.name: flushCompileCache
methods.description: Flushes the compile cache to disk for modules already loaded.

methods.name: getCompileCacheDir
methods.description: Returns the directory used for the module compile cache if enabled.

methods.name: findSourceMap
methods.description: Finds the source map for a given file path.

methods.name: setSourceMapsSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables source map support for stack traces.

methods.name: getSourceMapsSupport
methods.description: Returns the current source map support status.

methods.name: stripTypeScriptTypes
methods.description: Removes or transforms TypeScript type annotations in code.

methods.name: syncBuiltinESMExports
methods.description: Synchronizes live bindings of Node.js built-in ESM modules with their CommonJS exports.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a module with custom hooks for resolution and loading.

methods.name: registerHooks
methods.description: Registers resolution and load hooks for module resolution customization.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to a parent URL to an absolute URL.
